# mise

Sets up and changes mise (mise-en-place) in a repository, covering tool versions, environment values, tasks, the lockfile, test runs, and CI. Use when a repository needs a new mise.toml, when a tool, an environment value, or a task is added, upgraded, or removed, when test suites or the ci task are set up or changed, or when a choice is needed between mise backends, version files, task forms, or config files. Gives playbooks, templates, a chooser, and a script that checks the setup. Covers mise.toml, mise.lock, tool versions, task runner, dev environment, test tasks, and monorepo tasks.

Ships in the [`mise`](../../README.md) plugin of [Uraxii/dotai](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai). The agent reads [SKILL.md](SKILL.md); this file is for people.

## Requirements

Needs mise and bash.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install mise@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add mise@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install mise@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
